project_title: MME Private Limited - Corporate Industrial Hero Typography & Layout Redesign
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / HEAVY INDUSTRIAL PRECISION
overview: Focused visual design and typography overhaul for the MME (Mangal Murtey Enterprises Private Limited) home hero carousel. Transforms the 3-slide hero from generic text overlay into a world-class, high-impact industrial powerhouse hero faithful to the reference style: crisp industrial typography hierarchy, dual-tone punchy White (#FFFFFF) & Vibrant Safety Orange (#FF6B00 / #FF7A00) text pairing, high-contrast kicker pill, rich descriptive subheadings, dual primary + secondary CTA buttons, modern slide track controls, and deep navy-vignette industrial scrim overlays.

entry_surfaces./: Hero full-bleed 3-slide rotating canvas with cinematic navy-to-transparent scrim, high-impact dual-tone White & Orange headline typography, badge kicker, sub-headline paragraph, dual CTA buttons, slide counter track, and bottom scroll indicator

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update /app/frontend/src/content.js HERO array to incorporate rich multi-part title strings, distinctive kicker badges, high-impact industrial taglines, and secondary CTA metadata as specified in hero_slides_content_spec.

2. Redesign /app/frontend/src/components/Hero.jsx to render the new typography hierarchy matching the attached reference style: bold kicker badge pill, dynamic White + Vibrant Orange (#ff7a00) headline spans, high-readability subtitle copy, and dual CTAs (Primary Orange with hover translate, Secondary Glass/Outline).
3. Keep full carousel functionality (automatic rotation every 6.5s, slide indicators with active duration bar, next/prev click, paused/synced indicator tabs, and smooth Ken Burns image animations).

4. Ensure all interactive buttons, indicators, and links carry data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-slide-indicator-0', data-testid='hero-primary-cta', data-testid='hero-secondary-cta', data-testid='hero-scroll-down-btn').
5. Ensure dark navy multi-layer scrims are maintained so all White and Orange typography achieves flawless APCA/WCAG AA+ contrast against photographic backgrounds.
6. Verify mobile responsiveness: scale typography smoothly from text-3xl/4xl on mobile to text-6xl/7xl on desktop screens without word collisions or clipping.
